name: Specialist critic bank
goal: {{task}} Done when the merged review lists no blocker and no major finding, `{{test-command}}` passes, and a human accepts the change.

template.title: Specialist critic bank
template.summary: Four fresh specialist critics review in parallel, a triage judge merges their findings by severity, and the change loops until nothing blocker or major remains.
template.whenToUse: Multiple disjoint judges (correctness, security, performance, taste) should each look at the change, and their findings need merging by severity.
template.notFor: Small or low-risk changes, where one review-gate critic is enough; four reviewers and a judge cost four times a round.

slots.ask: What should be built or changed? One or two sentences a builder can act on.
slots.example: Add password reset by email to the account service in src/account/.

description: A builder works; four critics, each in a fresh context and each on one concern, review the same diff in parallel (at most four at a time). A frontier triage judge merges their reports into one list by severity and emits the verdict. Blockers or majors return to the builder; a clean list goes to a human, whose rejection also returns to the builder. The loop stops when the merged list is clean, at its round cap, or at its dispatch budget.

nodes.name: Builder
nodes.brief: Do the task in the code, with tests. On a later round, address every blocker and major in TRIAGE.md, or say why it does not apply; minors are optional. Run `{{test-command}}` before you report.

nodes.name: Correctness critic
nodes.brief: Review the change for correctness: wrong results, unhandled cases and missing tests; run `{{test-command}}` yourself only; other reviewers cover the rest. Rate each finding blocker, major or minor, with the file and line that shows it. You review; you do not fix. Report invalid-evidence rather than guessing when the diff cannot be read.
inputs: the repository as the change leaves it, read-only
outputs: REVIEW-CORRECTNESS.md: findings rated blocker, major or minor

nodes.name: Security critic
nodes.brief: Review the change for security: input handling, secrets, authentication and authorisation, and dependencies only; other reviewers cover the rest. Rate each finding blocker, major or minor, with the file and line that shows it. You review; you do not fix. Report invalid-evidence rather than guessing when the diff cannot be read.
inputs: the repository as the change leaves it, read-only
outputs: REVIEW-SECURITY.md: findings rated blocker, major or minor

nodes.name: Performance critic
nodes.brief: Review the change for performance: work that grows badly with input, needless I/O, and memory only; other reviewers cover the rest. Rate each finding blocker, major or minor, with the file and line that shows it. You review; you do not fix. Report invalid-evidence rather than guessing when the diff cannot be read.
inputs: the repository as the change leaves it, read-only
outputs: REVIEW-PERFORMANCE.md: findings rated blocker, major or minor

nodes.name: Taste critic
nodes.brief: Review the change for taste: naming, structure, readability and fit with the surrounding code only; other reviewers cover the rest. Rate each finding blocker, major or minor, with the file and line that shows it. You review; you do not fix. Report invalid-evidence rather than guessing when the diff cannot be read.
inputs: the repository as the change leaves it, read-only
outputs: REVIEW-TASTE.md: findings rated blocker, major or minor

nodes.name: Triage judge
nodes.description: Runs once per round, after all four reviews are in.
nodes.brief: Merge the four reviews into one list ranked blocker, major, minor, dropping duplicates and any finding its reviewer could not show. Emit the verdict: pass only when nothing is blocker or major. You rank; you do not review again and you do not fix.
outputs: TRIAGE.md: merged findings by severity and a verdict line

nodes.name: Accept the change
nodes.prompt: Triage found no blocker or major finding. Accept the change?
